en_title: Resident Evil Overtakes Weapons as Zach Cregger's Highest-Grossing Film, The Social Reckoning Bombs
subtitle: 恐怖片领跑，续作失利
opus_summary: 《生化危机》超越《凶器》，成为导演票房最高的作品，中国首映带动影片重返全球周末票房榜首。《社交网络》续作则票房失利，首周末仅列第七，影评人口碑也不佳。

paragraphs.en: Resident Evil beat Weapons to become director Zach Cregger's highest-grossing film while The Social Reckoning bombed at the box office.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机》超越《凶器》，成为导演Zach Cregger票房最高的电影；《The Social Reckoning》则票房惨败。

paragraphs.en: The live-action adaptation of Capcom's classic survival horror series turned heads as it reached an estimated worldwide total of $320.2 million over the weekend. With $138.5 million domestically and $181.7 million internationally, Resident Evil has officially cleared Weapons' $270 million with a few weeks and change to spare.
paragraphs.cn: 这部改编自卡普空经典生存恐怖游戏系列的真人电影表现亮眼，截至本周末，全球累计票房预计达到3.202亿美元(约合人民币21亿元)。其中，北美票房为1.385亿美元(约合人民币9亿元)，海外票房为1.817亿美元(约合人民币12亿元)。《生化危机》正式超过《凶器》的2.7亿美元(约合人民币18亿元)，达到这一成绩所用的时间还少了几周。

paragraphs.en: Cregger brought his re-imagined Raccoon City to the big screen on September 18, 2026, making this weekend its fourth in theaters. The massive jump – which saw it return to the number one spot, globally – was largely propelled by its premiere in China. Of the whopping $62.65 million it accumulated through weekend four, $40.6 million was earned in China alone. Its victory over Weapons already seemed secure, but as it stands atop Cregger's catalog, it's also continuing to leave its reported $75 million budget in the dust.
paragraphs.cn: Cregger重新构想的浣熊市于2026年9月18日登上大银幕，本周末是影片上映后的第四个周末。中国首映是本轮票房大幅增长的主要推力，也让影片重返全球周末票房榜首。第四个周末，影片共收获6,265万美元(约合人民币4亿元)，其中仅中国市场就贡献了4,060万美元(约合人民币3亿元)。此前，影片超过《凶器》似乎已无悬念；如今，它不仅登顶Cregger作品票房榜，累计票房也继续远远甩开据报道为7,500万美元(约合人民币5亿元)的制作预算。

paragraphs.en: Resident Evil's ongoing success in theaters kicked off when it brought in $108.3 million in its opening weekend. It was a strong start that even managed to bleed over into the gaming world with increased sales for some of the games, too, with Cregger's latest also landing as the highest-rated video game adaptation of all time.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机》首周末便拿下1.083亿美元(约合人民币7亿元)，由此开启了持续出色的院线表现。这一强劲开局甚至带动了游戏市场，让系列部分游戏销量上涨。Cregger的这部新作也成为有史以来评分最高的电子游戏改编电影。

paragraphs.en: It's hard to imagine the film's release going any better than it did, especially considering the months leading up to its premiere were plagued by negativity online. Gaming fans spent much of their time talking about the movie's lack of recognizable characters and its tweaks to the lore, with Cregger arguing that he made the changes in order to make a better movie . By just about every measure, it seems the bet paid off.
paragraphs.cn: 很难想象这部电影还能取得比现在更好的上映表现，尤其是考虑到首映前的几个月，网上一直充斥着负面声音。游戏粉丝的讨论大多围绕影片缺少熟悉的角色，以及对背景设定的改动展开。Cregger则辩称，这些改动是为了拍出更好的电影。几乎从各方面来看，这场押注似乎都得到了回报。

paragraphs.en: These mid-October box office results show signs of an audience ready for Halloween, with Other Mommy also performing well despite poor reviews from both critics and audiences alike (via Rotten Tomatoes ). Sitting with an abysmal 18% critic score and 47% audience score, Jessica Chastain's new horror movie landed in second place globally with 45.19 million (27.5 million domestically, $17.69 million internationally).
paragraphs.cn: 10月中旬的这些票房成绩显示，观众似乎已准备好迎接万圣节。根据烂番茄数据，《Other Mommy》在影评人和观众中口碑都不佳，但票房表现依然不错。杰西卡·查斯坦主演的这部恐怖新片，影评人好评率仅为18%，观众好评率为47%，却以4,519万美元(约合人民币3亿元)位列全球周末票房榜第二，其中北美票房为2,750万美元(约合人民币2亿元)，海外票房为1,769万美元(约合人民币1亿元)。

paragraphs.en: As bone-chilling trailers convinced scary movie fans to show up for an unnerving performance, there were also some notable losers in theaters, too. Tom Cruise's Digger continued its unfortunate run with $9.6 million in weekend two, marking a 48% drop for a total of $35.3 million. The true disappointment, though, was Aaron Sorkin's The Social Network sequel, The Social Reckoning.
paragraphs.cn: 令人毛骨悚然的预告片吸引恐怖片爱好者走进影院，观看让人不安的表演，但也有几部备受关注的电影票房失利。汤姆·克鲁斯主演的《Digger》继续表现不佳，第二个周末票房为960万美元(约合人民币6432万元)，下跌48%，累计票房达到3,530万美元(约合人民币2亿元)。不过，真正令人失望的是Aaron Sorkin执导的《社交网络》续作《The Social Reckoning》。

paragraphs.en: Starring Jeremy Allen White and Mikey Madison, and including Jeremy Strong's performance as Mark Zuckerberg, the film's opening weekend saw it open in seventh place with just $9 million. At $5.5 million domestically and $17.69 million internationally on a reported budget of $30 million (via Variety ), The Social Reckoning is a certified bomb.
paragraphs.cn: 该片由Jeremy Allen White和Mikey Madison主演，Jeremy Strong饰演马克·扎克伯格，首周末仅收获900万美元(约合人民币6030万元)，排名第七。据《综艺》报道，影片制作预算为3,000万美元(约合人民币2亿元)，北美票房为550万美元(约合人民币3685万元)，海外票房为1,769万美元(约合人民币1亿元)。《The Social Reckoning》的票房可谓彻底失败。

paragraphs.en: It's a painful reality for the Facebook movie follow-up, especially after Jesse Eisenberg's original picture ended its run with $224.9 million (via Box Office Mojo ) and plenty of praise. The Social Reckoning could always stand the test of time, but with a Rotten Tomatoes score of 55% from critics and 74% from audiences, it's not looking good.
paragraphs.cn: 对这部讲述Facebook故事的电影续作而言，这样的现实令人难受。尤其是杰西·艾森伯格主演的前作不仅广受赞誉，据Box Office Mojo统计，其最终票房还达到2.249亿美元(约合人民币15亿元)。《The Social Reckoning》仍有可能经受住时间的考验，但目前烂番茄影评人好评率为55%，观众好评率为74%，情况并不乐观。

paragraphs.en: October still has plenty to give, though. Capcom's live-action Street Fighter movie and Nathan Fielder's You Can See Everything will both release next weekend, October 16. DC body horror movie Clayface then follows October 23.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，10月仍有不少新片值得期待。卡普空的真人电影《街头霸王》和Nathan Fielder的《You Can See Everything》都将于下周末，也就是10月16日上映。DC肉体恐怖电影《泥脸》随后将于10月23日上映。

paragraphs.en: For the movies you can see in theaters now, be sure to check out IGN's reviews. We called Resident Evil "Great" with an 8/10 and Other Mommy "Bad" with a 4/10 . We talked about the highs and lows of Digger in our 6/10 review for the Cruise film, while The Social Reckoning returned a 7/10 .
paragraphs.cn: 至于目前正在上映的电影，可以参考IGN的评测。我们给《生化危机》打出8分（满分10分），评价为「优秀」；《Other Mommy》则获得4分，评价为「糟糕」。克鲁斯主演的《Digger》获得6分，我们在评测中讨论了影片的优缺点；《The Social Reckoning》则获得7分。
